source.name: ABC News Victorian election policy tracker

ALP: Recruit 1,500 police officers and open a second police academy at Wyndham
Spend $62 million recruiting up to 200 police reservists for desk duties
Lift sentences for serious sexual offences, including life maximum for rape
Set a 30-year standard sentence for murdering a partner
Create a permanent $170 million organised crime unit
Invest $66.5 million in police technology, including cybercrime tools
Fund $10m council CCTV and lighting fund plus $10m venue security fund
Introduce Clare's law and ban smart glasses at community facilities
LNP: Reopen more than 40 police stations and recruit 3,000 extra officers
Hire 200 PSOs for train stations and 200 for high-risk shopping precincts
Bring in RICO-style laws aimed at organised crime leaders
Introduce a one-strike bail rule for offending while on bail
Extend adult sentencing for youths to 20 serious offences, including carjacking
Invest $100 million in youth early intervention and rehabilitation
Criminalise coercive control and introduce Clare's law
GRN: Fund a $1 billion Office of Community Safety and Crime Prevention
Repeal the 2025 changes that strengthened bail laws
Raise the age of criminal responsibility to 14
End life sentences for children
Ban police drug-detection dogs
Decriminalise personal use and possession of small amounts of drugs
ONP: Offer sign-on bonuses to veterans, defence members and interstate or overseas police
Provide police accommodation allowances and on-call mental health support
Charge children accused of serious violent offences as adults
Return the age of criminal responsibility to 10
Make parents liable for fines or damage caused by their children
Build Magistrates' Courts at Melton, Epping and Pakenham; raise magistrates to 170
Set up a 24/7 bail court and presumption against bail for repeat offenders
Introduce UK-style home self-defence laws and trial legal capsicum spray

ALP: Spend $230 million on 10 free public dental clinics, three in regional Victoria
Invest $277 million in Werribee Mercy emergency department and other hospital upgrades
Provide $125 million for Thomas Embling forensic mental health hospital
Commit $240.5 million to western Melbourne maternity services, adding 32 post-natal beds
Add $53.6 million to the Victorian Patient Transport Assistance Scheme
Make abortion care free
LNP: Spend $1.27 billion on 25,000 extra elective surgeries a year
Guarantee $99 million for hospital patient transit lounges
Build an $850 million West Gippsland Hospital at Drouin East
Commit $350 million to Wonthaggi Hospital and $180 million to Mildura Base
Fund Albury Wodonga Health ($100m) and Hamilton Base Hospital ($45m)
Provide $5 million to plan a youth mental health facility in Parkville
Make abortion care free, matching Labor
GRN: Keep VicHealth and mandate 5% of health budget for prevention
Mandate 3% of health spending for community health services
Invest $3 billion in 20 public dental clinics and free dental for all
Seek $15 million for abortion access and $10 million for public homebirth
Make abortion and contraceptive care free
Legalise cannabis and expand pill testing and supervised injecting rooms
ONP: Cut hospital administration and fund more doctors and nurses
Guarantee 24/7 emergency departments and minimum services in regional areas
Allow nurse-led discharging and prescribing
Fund a $136 million families package supporting expectant mothers
Scrap standalone DEI and ESG programs and redirect savings to frontline care
Standardise and link electronic medical records statewide
No planned changes to abortion laws

ALP: Spend $352 million to double potholes fixed from 250,000 to 500,000
Pilot minimum-security prisoners doing roadside maintenance
Upgrade the Western Freeway between Melton and Caroline Springs for $550 million
Upgrade Somerton Road, Greenvale ($494m) and duplicate Hallam Road ($350m)
Upgrade Findon Road, Epping ($270m) and widen Point Cook Road ($195m)
Widen Evans Road, Cranbourne West ($180m) and Taylors Road, Kings Park ($170m)
Replace a Hoppers Crossing roundabout with lights ($90m); Wyndham Vale roads ($83m)
Invest nearly $49 million in motorcycle safety and licensing
LNP: Pledge $5 billion for road repairs, a 25% maintenance spending boost
Fix one million potholes through a new government repair body
Give 48 regional councils $288 million for local roads and bridges
Duplicate Donnybrook Road between Woodstock and Kalkallo for $524 million
Duplicate Thompsons Road from Clyde North to Officer South for $607 million
GRN: Return VicRoads to government hands and redirect savings to road repairs
Dedicate 5% of transport budget to safe bike routes
Introduce 30km/h speed limits in residential streets
Extend truck bans in Kensington, North Melbourne and West Melbourne
Double registration fees for vehicles with bonnets over 120cm wide
ONP: Publish condition and funding of every major regional road
Create a public pothole reporting portal
Lock in ongoing regional road funding and clear the maintenance backlog

ALP: Build 25,600 homes for first home buyers at market prices, starting 2027
Deliver 300,000-plus homes by 2051 through Activity Centres with up to 20-storey towers
Redevelop the Collingwood cohealth site with 69 social homes
Wind land tax back to previous levels over six years
LNP: Scrap Labor's Activity Centres and give locals more say in planning
Extend the Capital City Zone to Fishermans Bend, North Melbourne, Fitzroy, Collingwood
Return the land tax threshold to 2023 levels
GRN: Spend $4 billion on 88,000 new public homes and upgrades
Stop planned demolition of public housing towers
Replace auctions with fixed-price home sales
Abolish stamp duty under $1.1 million; discount it under $1.6 million
Freeze rents statewide for two years and in each new tenancy's first two years
Link rent increases to wage growth or inflation
Fund a $50 million rental regulator with landlord licensing
ONP: Review new-home fees, taxes and charges and cut unjustified ones
Increase foreign purchaser duty on residential property
Free up granny flats and spare-room rentals from state interference
Require community consultation before high-rises in established suburbs
Offer incentives for low-cost housing and release under-used government land

ALP: Build the Suburban Rail Loop, cutting $1 billion in extras like station parking
Seek another $1 billion in savings via review, for a $32.3 billion total
Buy 25 X'Trapolis 2.0 trains for $673.6 million for Craigieburn and Upfield lines
Fund an $80 million study into duplicating the Upfield line
Spend $400 million on western suburbs buses running every 10 minutes
LNP: Pause and review the Suburban Rail Loop
Buy 25 hybrid electric trains for Melton and Wyndham Vale lines for $1.7 billion
Move replaced trains to regional Victoria for peak capacity
GRN: Make all public transport permanently free
Run trams and trains at least every 10 minutes, 7am to 10pm
Build a second Metro tunnel, reconfigure the City Loop, electrify Melton line
Fix the Altona Loop
Spend $270m on buses, $245m on regional services, $225m on accessible tram stops
ONP: Cancel the Suburban Rail Loop and redirect funds to other projects
Electrify the Melton line and complete the Airport Rail Link

ALP: Build a $10.73 million performing arts centre at Keilor Downs College
Upgrade The Grange P-12 College in Hoppers Crossing for $19.74 million
Reform the curriculum and assessment authority (VCAA) for $222.2 million
Spend $59.4 million on free uniforms and breakfasts for struggling families
Open a public apprenticeship academy with 2,000 electrical apprenticeships over four years
LNP: Build three new select-entry high schools and convert six existing schools
Spend $222 million on 10 technical schools for up to 5,000 students
Create a $115 million fund covering half of apprentices' off-the-job training
Reform classroom behaviour and review curriculum to ease teacher workloads
GRN: End voluntary parent contributions to make public schools fully free
Push for free university and review Victoria's eight public university acts
Put students and staff on university councils; cap vice-chancellor pay
Embed First Nations frameworks in early childhood education
Explore anti-racism and social cohesion programs in the curriculum
ONP: Replace the curriculum with a knowledge-rich syllabus focused on core subjects
Introduce school vouchers so families can choose schools
Expand trade schools and ease setting up independent and specialist schools

ALP: Keep the net zero by 2045 emissions target
Continue transmission projects linking western renewables to the grid
Commission an independent cost review of the Western Renewables Link
Create a mineral royalties fund raising $500 million over four years for regions
Require a 2km buffer between new waste-to-energy plants and homes
LNP: Fund 335 fire trucks and 17 CFA stations through a $200 million plan
No plans to change the net zero by 2045 target
Cancel VNI West and halt the Western Renewables Link pending review
Reinstate a 2km buffer between wind turbines and homes
Repeal the ban on gas in homes and allow new gas projects
Introduce urban solar parks on commercial rooftops
Guarantee weekly red bin collection and drop the glass bin mandate
Double planned burns and process native timber at Victorian sawmills
GRN: Create a $1 billion climate adaptation fund for disaster-hit communities
Invest $2 billion in SEC solar on schools, public housing and government buildings
Impose a moratorium on AI data centres and waste-to-energy incinerators
Block new fossil fuel projects, including Viva's Geelong gas terminal
Close Loy Yang A power station earlier than planned
Ban native forest logging, duck hunting, greyhound and jumps racing
ONP: Scrap all net zero targets and subsidies
Repeal Victoria's ban on nuclear energy
Cancel VNI West, the Western Renewables Link and other large transmission projects
Reverse the ban on gas in homes and support offshore gas extraction
Ban new data centres and battery storage on farmland
Require consultation and water plans for data centres and batteries near homes
Support duck and deer hunting; eradicate European carp and redfin

ALP: Maintain Treaty
Allocate nearly $170 million over four years to First Peoples initiatives
Fund a $7.6 million Koori Hearing List at Melbourne Magistrates' Court
Spend $16 million on 30 homes in a First Nations rent-to-buy pilot
Direct $86 million of the Social Housing Growth Fund to First Nations housing
LNP: Legislate to repeal Treaty within the first 100 days
Return Indigenous policy to a department reporting to a minister
Fund $52 million for urgent care through 16 Aboriginal community-controlled organisations
GRN: Keep Treaty and pursue further local and statewide treaties
Restructure the environment department around First Nations knowledge and nature protection
Create a $2 billion nature fund supporting First Nations-led restoration
Hand management of national and state parks to Traditional Owners
ONP: Scrap Treaty and abolish Gellung Warl, redirecting its funding

ALP: Cap public transport fares at $30 a week for two years
Spend $191 million on a $30 weekly toll cap for smaller vehicles
LNP: Promise no new or increased taxes and repeal several Labor taxes
Cut payroll tax
Raise first home buyer stamp duty-free threshold to $1 million
Review tolling and cap tolls at $50 a week, costing $90 million a year
Return the budget to cash surplus by 2032
GRN: Provide $500 million in household vouchers for solar, batteries and insulation
Offer free energy assessments for renters
Give up to $3,000 off electric cars, e-bikes and two-way chargers
Set aside capped $50 lottery tickets for state-funded major events
ONP: Repeal Labor's land tax increases
Raise the payroll tax threshold to exempt more small employers
Abolish 10% stamp duty on home, contents and car insurance
Give $150 sport vouchers per school-age child in a $136 million package

ALP: Create 5,000 manufacturing jobs with a $350 million grants and co-investment package
Let all pubs trade until 3am and fast-track liquor licences
Amend the Food Act 1984 to allow dogs inside pubs
Put $80 million into the Victorian Racing Industry Fund
LNP: Sell the Epping wholesale fruit and vegetable market, raising $578 million
Standardise local business rules and modernise home-business planning rules
Make Service Victoria the single platform for all business approvals
Set up a Business Approvals Concierge to resolve delays
Fast-track approvals for music festivals, outdoor events and liquor licences
Create a $40 million Major Events Attraction Fund
GRN: Levy 3% on vacant Melbourne commercial properties, raising $100 million a year
Trial a four-day week and legislate a right to work from home
Spend $100 million on paid sick leave for casual workers
Cut state defence spending to zero and end weapons supply contracts with US and Israel
Ban weapons expos in Victoria
ONP: Remove stamp duty on establishing new businesses
Raise the payroll tax threshold to exempt more small employers

ALP: Save $2 billion on the Suburban Rail Loop to fund promises
Wind up bodies like Infrastructure Victoria; merge the SRL Authority and VIDA
Cut consultant and adviser spending, saving $70 million
Stop ministerial spending on non-essential items like branded merchandise
Use $200 million unallocated Innovation Victoria funds for manufacturing jobs pledge
LNP: Save $22 billion over 10 years via public service hiring freeze and executive pay caps
Save $1 billion over 10 years by scrapping Treaty
Fund $1.27 billion elective surgery pledge by scrapping Breakthrough Victoria
Raise $578 million by selling the Melbourne wholesale market
GRN: Pursue a wealth tax on investors with over $5 million in residential property
Impose a 0.1% quarterly levy on the big five banks, raising $3 billion-plus yearly
Raise pokies tax to 75% and online gambling tax to 25%
Double taxes on casino table games
ONP: Scrap the Suburban Rail Loop and redirect its funds
Cut bureaucracy and bring in sunset reviews of government bodies
Redirect funding from Treaty
